title: Watcher Crossbow
summary: Steel Watcher-only heavy crossbow hits for 3d10 Piercing.

fields.Weapon profile: 3d10 Piercing plus Dexterity. Martial, two-handed ranged weapon, 60 ft. Steel Watchers only.
fields.Piercing Shot: Action, ranged weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes hits on the target gain 2 extra Piercing damage. In Honour Mode it takes 2 extra damage of the original type from damage sources. Healing clears the condition. Once per Short Rest with proficiency. The standard action can extend Gaping Wounds to 4 turns with Crossbow Expert: Wounding. This crossbow is restricted to Steel Watchers.
fields.Brace: Spend 20 ft movement once per Short Rest. Reroll ranged damage and take the higher result until turn end. Breaks Hiding and Invisibility.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
